fields.summary: User can reset their password via an emailed link
fields.description:
As a registered user I want to reset my password through a link sent to my email so that I can regain access when I forget it.

Project Key: SMOKE
Issue ID (numeric): 10001

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Submitting a registered email address on the 'Forgot password' form sends an email with a single-use password-reset link that is valid for 60 minutes.
2. Opening a reset link more than 60 minutes after it was sent shows the message 'This reset link has expired' and a 'Request a new link' button.

attachments.reset-policy.md:
Password reset policy
- A reset link stays valid for 60 minutes.
- At most 3 reset requests per account per hour.

bugs.summary: [Password Reset] - POST /api/password-reset returns HTTP 500 instead of HTTP 200
bugs.description:
## Description
An error occurred during the execution of step: "Send POST /api/password-reset with a registered email address". The request failed with an AssertionError: expected response status 200 but received 500. HTTP 500 Internal Server Error was returned and no password-reset email was queued.

Error Message:
`AssertionError: expected response status 200 but received 500`

## Environment Details
- Agent: Smoke API Test Executor (version 9.9-smoke)
- Environment: Smoke Test Environment

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Ensure a user account exists for the test email address (email=registered@example.com).
2. Send POST /api/password-reset with registered email address (email=registered@example.com).

## Expected Result
HTTP 200 and a password-reset email is queued.

## Actual Result
HTTP 500 Internal Server Error; no email was queued.
